findings.evidence: charPoints (line 79): `pointsMap (zpowersHom M m)`; powEnd (line 116): `pointsMap (zpowersHom (Multiplicative ℤ) (Multiplicative.ofAdd n))` — identical for M = Multiplicative ℤ, m = ofAdd n.
findings.fix: Either define powEnd n := charPoints (Multiplicative.ofAdd n) and derive powEnd_one/powEnd_comp from charPoints (powEnd_comp becomes charPoints_comp specialized), or drop powEnd entirely and state the pairing theorem as charPoints m ∘ cocharPoints ψ = charPoints (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pairing m ψ)). Add a lemma recording powEnd n = charPoints (ofAdd n) if powEnd is kept for exposition.
findings.issue: powEnd n := pointsMap (zpowersHom (Multiplicative ℤ) (Multiplicative.ofAdd n)) is definitionally equal to charPoints (Multiplicative.ofAdd n) instantiated at M = Multiplicative ℤ (charPoints m := pointsMap (zpowersHom M m), lines 79–81). A character of 𝔾ₘ = D(Multiplicative ℤ) is exactly an endomorphism of 𝔾ₘ, so powEnd and its lemmas (powEnd_one, powEnd_comp, pointsMulEquiv_powEnd) duplicate the character API specialized to M = Multiplicative ℤ.

findings.evidence: cocharPoints (line 100) `:= pointsMap ψ`; pointsMap def at DiagonalizableGroupFunctoriality.lean:72 already has signature `(φ : G →* G') → WithConv(...G') →* WithConv(...G)`.
findings.fix: Drop cocharPoints and use pointsMap ψ directly, keeping only the on-points computation lemma (pointsMulEquiv_cocharPoints) which carries the actual content; or justify the alias as roadmap-facing naming.
findings.issue: cocharPoints ψ := pointsMap ψ is a pure rename of pointsMap with an identical signature (M →* Multiplicative ℤ already has the required type); it adds no specialization, unlike charPoints which composes with the generator hom.

summary: The character/cocharacter/pairing declarations are new and reuse pointsMap and Mathlib's zpowersHom/apply_mint/ext_mint well, but powEnd is a definitional special case of charPoints (the character of 𝔾ₘ at ofAdd n) and cocharPoints is a bare alias of pointsMap.
